name: evidence-lab-plugins
description: Evidence Lab plugin marketplace: domain plugins that bundle research skills, commands and subagents into installable units.

plugins.name: research-core
plugins.description: Core, cross-disciplinary research workflows for literature discovery and citations, study planning, exploratory analysis, statistics, uncertainty, critical review, scientific figures, and evidence-bounded writing. Use for ordinary research work before a domain-specific plugin is needed. It does not provide clinical decisions, laboratory control, domain pipelines, or a dedicated PDF extraction backend.
